sources.title: SmolLM3: smol, multilingual, long-context reasoner - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model demonstrates strong multilingual performance across five major European languages when evaluated on multilingual benchmarks including Global MMLU, MLMM HellaSwag, Flores-200, Belebele, testing knowledge, commonsense reasoning, text understanding, and translation. This shows SmolLM3 maintains consistent performance beyond English.

sources.title: SmolLM3 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SmolLM3 is a fully open, compact language model designed for efficient deployment while maintaining strong performance. It uses a Transformer decoder architecture with Grouped Query Attention (GQA) to reduce the kv cache, and no RoPE, enabling improved performance on long-context tasks.

sources.title: SmolLM3-3B - atomic.chat
sources.snippet: SmolLM3-3B is a 3-billion-parameter decoder-only language model released by Hugging Face in 2025. It is an instruction-tuned model with dual-mode reasoning, native support for six languages, and context handling up to 128K tokens.

sources.title: SmolLM3-3B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview SmolLM3-3B is a 3-billion parameter decoder-only transformer language model built by HuggingFaceTB that combines instruction-following with hybrid reasoning capabilities. The model uses Grouped Query Attention (GQA) and NoPE (No Position Embeddings) with a 3:1 ratio, trained on 11.2 trillion tokens through a staged curriculum of web, code, math, and reasoning data. sources.title: alibayram/smollm3
sources.snippet: SmolLM3 is a 3B parameter language model designed to push the boundaries of small models. It supports 6 languages, advanced reasoning and long context. SmolLM3 is a fully open model that offers strong performance at the 3B-4B scale.
